name: Melaka and George Town, Historic Cities of the Straits of Malacca
description: Two old port towns on Malaysia's Strait of Malacca coast, Melaka and George Town grew from five centuries of trade between East and West. In Melaka, you can walk among fortifications, churches, squares and government buildings left by the Malay sultanate, then the Portuguese and Dutch. George Town, on Penang, shows the British era through its streets of shophouses and homes, shaped by Malay, Chinese and South Asian communities.
